content.comment_body: Hello, where can I locate the specification that indicates the maximum possible nesting depth supported by [product_name] [article_no]? Additionally, I'm searching for an official description from [company_name] about the purpose of layout memory. Thanks. [user_name]

[user_name], try searching for 'memory space' in the help resources for [product_name]. You may find more information there. Also, check the attached file—this is what I found, though it's unclear if it applies only to [article_no] or more generally. [product_name] limits the nesting depth in your circuit program to a maximum of 58 objects: 1 input + 56 blocks + 1 output. So the deepest possible circuit program is made up of 58 total objects.

Thanks! That helped clarify the maximum nesting depth. Using 'memory space' as a search term was a good suggestion. I did a quick search in the [product_name] manual ([article_no]), but couldn't find the answer there. If anyone knows where to find an official definition for 'layout memory', please share. Regards.
